data.comment: Implementation: appended the MunitoAI remote tier (provider MunitoAI, endpoint https://api.munito.ai/inference, model deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash, api_key_env MUNITOAI_API_KEY) as the final tier of plan/author/code in proxy/config.yaml AND proxy/config-fast.yaml (fast overlay replaces provider lists wholesale; cheap inherits the base). Regenerated the 4 golden fixtures (merged_config_{fast,cheap}, prededup_raw_{fast,cheap}) so the config-merge equivalence contracts still hold. Added proxy/tests/test_munitoai_fallback_chain.py (17 tests): chain membership/position, resolved-model header, always-available (no available_times), and MUNITOAI_API_KEY resolution from ~/.pi/agent/auth.json key munitoai. Assumptions: endpoint is the base URL (proxy appends /v1/chat/completions); forward_session_headers: false set as a precaution. Base+fast updated symmetrically to keep mode-grandfathering remote-provider counts balanced.
